fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) declined 7.2% on November 13, estimated to be affected by the AI stock selloff following Nvidia's sudden leadership resignation.
fields.summary_ko.1: DELL's AI server revenue was $16.4 billion in Q2 2027, representing approximately 35% of total revenue of $47 billion, with record unshipped AI orders (backlog) of $95 billion.
